thread:
mia_cs: Heads-up — Sentinel trial onboarding health looks shaky. p99 latency spikes and token cost are higher than expected, customer flagged as 'likely churn' if not fixed this week. pulling logs now.

mia_cs: key numbers: ~60% of requests see spikes >800ms, cache miss rate ~30%, avg tokens/request 420. they're on redwood-v1-large.

david_se: thanks. initial thoughts: try int8 quantization profile + lower-memory kernel, and a temporary model swap to v1-medium to check quality delta quickly. should reduce latency and cost.

david_se: quick A/B plan: 10% of traffic -> v1-medium-quant, 70% -> v1-large-quant, 20% fallback to v1-large (no quant) for parity checks. run for 24-48h, monitor rouge/bleu on eval set + business metrics.

nate_infra: can do routing policy. suggest routing by request token length and latency SLO: short requests (<200 tokens) -> medium-quant; long requests -> large-quant; fallback region -> eu-west-1 if us-east saturated.

nate_infra: sample routing snippet i can apply now: ```json
{"policy":"workload_length","rules":[{"if":"tokens<200","route":"v1-medium-quant"},{"if":"latency>600","route":"v1-large"}]}
```

ravi_eng: if we quantize, we should run the eval harness on their golden prompts. I'll spin up the eval job and add a quality regression alert at 0.5% drop in accept rate.

ravi_eng: also recommend enabling KV-prefix cache for their common prompt templates — that should cut token recomputation on multi-turn flows.

mia_cs: propose outreach: schedule an enablement call with customer success + SE + infra tomorrow. show them numbers, get signoff for canary.

david_se: rough cost delta estimate: medium-quant -> ~35% lower $/token, latency p95 down ~30-40% on test traces. I'll post exact sims by EOD.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: routing-policy change queued by nate_infra, will execute on approval.

mia_cs: ok locking in: ravi -> eval harness + alerts, nate -> routing canary + autoscale policy, david -> cost sims + rollout playbook, i'll schedule the call and loop in account owner.

david_se: one more: if quality drops >0.6% we auto-rollback to v1-large and open a postmortem for model choice.

mia_cs: +1. capture feedback during call, update renewal risk in Salesforce after results. :thumbsup:

nate_infra: starting canary in 15m on dev copy, will report logs to this thread.

ops-bot: logs: canary-deploy started at 1763510000, track at /internal/canaries/1763510000

mia_cs: thanks team — goal is quick win before renewal touchpoint next week. I’ll paste customer notes after the call.
